name: Rock Art in the Hail Region of Saudi Arabia
description: In Saudi Arabia's Ha'il Region, two sandstone sites hold thousands of rock carvings of people and animals, made over roughly 10,000 years. At Jubbah, on the edge of the Nafud desert, the carvings gather around a hill range that once overlooked a freshwater lake, a lifeline for travellers and herds. At Shuwaymis, more figures line the cliffs of a wadi now filled with sand.
